caption: The drawing features a pastoral scene composed mainly of earth tones and muted colors. In the foreground, there are two white swans with black accents on their wings swimming on a greenish pond. To the right, a young girl with light brown hair is standing; she is dressed in a red dress with a white apron and black shoes. To her left, a boy is bending down beside the edge of the pond, extending his arm outward; he wears a tan shirt, green trousers, and a brown hat. In the background, the left side shows a cluster of green and beige trees and shrubs, with more light tan and green foliage extending along the shore. Light beige rock formations appear beyond the trees, and the sky is rendered as a solid dark background. Some red flowers are visible in the foreground among the grass. The design is contained within a rectangular frame set against a light tan or off-white background, and a signature, "Pearl Hibbs," appears at the lower left of the page.
title: Cotton Cloth
